title: AI 助手
urlHint: HTTPS；需要時包含 /v1 或 /v1beta，不要填完整聊天位址
keySaved: 此服務的金鑰已安全儲存，重啟後自動重用；留空不修改
keyHint: 輸入後自動儲存到裝置安全保險庫
modelHint: 清單來自目前服務。可用不代表支援工具呼叫；失敗時選其他模型。
privacy: 對話及按需讀取的程式碼（含私有倉庫）會傳送至你設定的 AI 服務。請使用可信服務。GitHub token 留在裝置，僅用於登入帳號的 GitHub 請求；歷史和稽核在本地加密保存。
restore_item: 還原 Issue / PR 欄位
operationFinished: 操作已處理，請查看紀錄
contextHint: Use the current GitHub account to list your repositories
buildReady: 編譯完成，開啟 AI 對話下載產物
buildFailed: 編譯未成功，請查看 Actions
starsPartial: 已載入前 2000 個星標，搜尋限於這些倉庫
watchScope: 執行時約每 5 分鐘檢查預設分支提交及新 Release，回到前景後補查。關閉或被系統終止時無法即時提醒。
added: 新增程式碼行（已測量提交）
deletedLines: 刪除程式碼行（已測量提交）
statsScope: 範圍：目前帳號可搜尋到的本人提交，依提交日期歸月；最多測量 100 個提交的增刪行。不是 GitHub 貢獻日曆，不含未索引提交；行數不是淨程式碼量。
statsPartial: 結果包含抽樣或請求失敗；行數僅為成功測量部分
accountChanged: 帳號已切換，請重新操作
ambiguousRepo: 無法唯一確定倉庫，請用 owner/repo
detectFirst: 請先偵測模型，再儲存啟用設定
disabled: 請在 AI 設定啟用助手
fileTooLarge: 檔案或提案太大，無法安全處理
headChanged: 遠端內容已變更，拒絕覆寫；請重新讀取及預覽
invalidEndpoint: 請設定有效 HTTPS API 根位址
invalidProposal: AI 修改提案不完整或無效
invalidRepo: 請先選有效的 owner/repo 倉庫
invalidResponse: API 回傳無法識別的結果
keyRequired: 請先為此服務設定 API Key
loginRequired: 請先登入 GitHub 帳號
modelLimit: 模型清單超過分頁上限
modelUnavailable: 所選模型無法使用，請重新偵測
requestFailed: 請求失敗，請查網路、金鑰、API 權限及工具支援
responseTruncated: 模型輸出被截斷，未執行提案；請縮小任務
secretFile: 禁止透過 AI 讀取或修改憑據檔案
toolLimit: 已達工具呼叫上限，請縮小任務
treeTruncated: 倉庫檔案樹不完整，未提交修改
unknownTool: 不支援此 AI 操作
unsupportedFile: 不支援修改符號連結、子模組或二進位檔案
watchFailed: 倉庫更新檢查失敗，下次重試
cancelled: 操作已取消，未執行本次提案
manualModel: Enter any model ID; model listing is optional
probeHint: Manual detection makes a few short requests and may incur charges; override the results below
writeConfirmation: Every GitHub mutation requires confirmation; this cannot be disabled
autoSummary: Preserve goals and key conversation excerpts
priceHint: Enter provider prices; cost is an estimate. Missing usage is explicitly labeled estimated
themeHint: Light, dark and system appearance use the app theme settings
structured: 允許 JSON 格式回覆（僅在明確要求時啟用）
quickReposTask: List repositories accessible to my current GitHub account, including private repositories.
quickAnalyzeTask: Analyze the current repository using relevant files. Ask for a target if none is selected.
quickCodeTask: Review code in the current repository, locating relevant source before reading.
quickFixTask: Help fix a bug in the current repository. Ask about the symptoms, then read relevant code and preview changes.
quickActionsTask: Inspect recent GitHub Actions runs and failing steps in the current repository.
quickIssuesTask: Summarize recent Issues and PRs in the current repository, identifying pending work.
repositoryRequired: Choose a repository for this operation; listing your repositories does not require one
budgetExceeded: 這次內容過長，請縮小檔案範圍或拆成幾個問題；歷史紀錄已保留
historyCorrupt: Unable to load chat history; original data has been preserved
unauthorized: Authentication failed (401); check the account or API key
forbidden: Access denied (403); check repository or API permissions
rateLimit: API rate limit reached; retry later
incompatibleApi: API rejected the parameters; check model, tools and output settings
streamInterrupted: Stream interrupted; received text has been preserved
responseTooLarge: API response too large; reduce the request scope
connectionFailed: Connection failed or timed out; check your network and retry
contextFilesTask: Read these repository files as context first:
confirmDeletion: 單獨確認刪除下列檔案
automaticBudgetHint: 應用程式會依所選模式自動管理上下文與回覆長度，無需填寫預算。較大的工具結果會按需分段讀取。
conflict: 儲存庫介紹已被其他操作變更，請重新產生預覽
